cues.en: Very possible, Lizzie. Very possible. Alright. Good glass of chatteler chatteler, aide, just say up. Oh, you're right there, old mediole. Alright. Who would have thought thirty years ago,
cues.zh: 很有可能，Lizzie。很有可能。好吧。来杯好喝的 Chatteler Chatteler，助手，直接说吧。噢，你就在那儿呢，老伙计。好吧。三十年前谁能想到，

cues.en: we'd all be sitting here drinking Chateau de Chasseleur.
cues.zh: 我们会坐在这儿喝 Chateau de Chasseleur。

cues.en: Them days, we're glad to have the price of a cup of tea. Alright. A cup of cold tea. Without milk or sugar or tea.
cues.zh: 那时候，能喝上一杯茶就很满足了。好吧，一杯凉茶。没奶没糖，也没茶叶。

cues.en: In a cracked cup and all? Oh, we never used to have a cup. We used to have to drink out of a rolled up newspaper.
cues.zh: 还装在裂了口的杯子里？噢，我们那时候连杯子都没有，只能用卷起来的报纸喝。

cues.en: The best we could manage was to suck on a piece of damp cloth.
cues.zh: 我们能做到最好的，也就是吸一吸湿布上的水。

cues.en: But, you know, we were happy in those days, although we were poor. Because we were poor. Aye. My old dad used to say to me, money doesn't bring you happiness, son. He was right. Aye. I was happier then, and I had nothing.
cues.zh: 但是，你知道，那时候我们虽然穷，却很快乐。就是因为我们穷。是啊。我老爸过去常对我说，儿子，钱并不能带来快乐。他说得对。没错。那时候我更快乐，尽管我一无所有。

cues.en: We used to live in this tiny old tumbledown house with great big holes in the roof. House, you were lucky to live in a house. We used to live in one room, all 26 of us. No furniture. Half the floor was missing. We're all huddled together in one corner for fear of falling. You
cues.zh: 我们以前住在又小又破的破烂房子里，屋顶上还有好几个大窟窿。房子？能有房子住你就算走运了。我们以前住在一个房间里，整整26个人。没有家具。地板还少了一半。我们全都缩在一个角落里，生怕掉下去。你

cues.en: were lucky to have a room. We used to have to live in the corridor.
cues.zh: 能有个房间就算走运了。我们以前不得不住在走廊里。

cues.en: Oh, we used to dream of living in a corridor.
cues.zh: 哦，我们以前还梦想住在走廊里呢。

cues.en: Would have been a palace to us.
cues.zh: 那对我们来说都算宫殿了。

cues.en: We used to live in an old water tank on a rubbish tip.
cues.zh: 我们以前住在一个垃圾场里的旧水箱里。

cues.en: We got woke up every morning by having a load of rotting fish dumped all over us.
cues.zh: 每天早上被一大堆烂鱼倒在我们身上吵醒。

cues.en: House.
cues.zh: 房子。

cues.en: Well, when I say house, it was just a hole in the ground covered by a sheet of tarpaulin,
cues.zh: 嗯，我说房子，其实只是地上一个洞，上面盖了块防水布，

cues.en: but it was a house to us.
cues.zh: 但对我们来说那就是房子。

cues.en: We were evicted from our hole in the ground.
cues.zh: 我们被从那个地洞里赶了出来。

cues.en: We had to go and live in a lake.
cues.zh: 只好搬去湖里住了。

cues.en: You were lucky to have a lake. There are a 150 of us living in a shoebox in the middle of the road.
cues.zh: 你们有湖可真幸运。我们150个人住在马路中间的一个鞋盒里。

cues.en: Cardboard box. Aye. You were lucky.
cues.zh: 纸板箱。没错。你们真幸运。

cues.en: We
cues.zh: 我们

cues.en: lived for three months in a rolled up newspaper in a septic tank.
cues.zh: 在化粪池里卷起来的报纸中住了三个月。

cues.en: We used to have to get up every morning at 06:00 and clean the newspaper, go to work down the mill fourteen hours a day, week in, week out for six months a week. And when we got home, our dad would thrash us to sleep with his belt.
cues.zh: 我们以前每天早上6点就得起床，把报纸清理干净，然后去磨坊上班，一天干14个小时，连续干半年。回到家后，爸爸还会用皮带把我们抽到睡着。

cues.en: Luxury.
cues.zh: 那叫奢华。

cues.en: We used to have to get out of the lake at 03:00 in the morning, clean the lake, eat a handful of hot gravel, work twenty hours a day at mill for twopence a month, come home, and dad would beat us around the head and neck with a broken bottle if we were lucky.
cues.zh: 我们以前每天凌晨三点就得从湖里爬出来，把湖清理干净，吃一把热碎石当饭，在磨坊每天干二十个小时，一个月才拿两便士，回到家，要是运气好的话，还得挨老爸拿破瓶子往头上脖子上招呼。

cues.en: Well, of course, we had it tough.
cues.zh: 哎，当然了，我们当年日子确实苦。

cues.en: We used to have to get them out of the shoebox in the middle of the night and lick the road clean with our tongues.
cues.zh: 我们以前大半夜就得把他们从鞋盒里弄出来，还得用舌头把马路舔得干干净净。

cues.en: We had to eat hard behind them for the freezing cold gravel, work twenty four hours of that milk for four months ever since years. And when we got home, all done would slice it into it with a bread knife.
cues.zh: 我们只能跟在他们后面，冒着严寒踩着冻硬的石子路，四个月来每天干满二十四小时的活，就这样过了好些年。等回到家，干完的活儿都得用面包刀切开。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: had to get up in the morning at 10:00 at night, half an hour before I went to bed,
cues.zh: 早上10点就得起床，而那其实是前一天的晚上，比上床睡觉还早半小时，

cues.en: eat a lump of coal poison, work twenty nine hours a day down mill, and pay mill owner for permission to come to work. And when we got home, our dad would kill us and dance about in our grave singing hallelujah.
cues.zh: 吃一块煤渣毒药，在磨坊里一天干二十九个小时，还得给磨坊主交钱才能来上班。等我们回到家，我爸会把我们打死，还在我们坟头跳来跳去唱哈利路亚。

cues.en: Are you trying to tell the young people of today that?
cues.zh: 你是想把这个告诉现在的年轻人吗？

cues.en: And they won't believe you. No. They won't.
cues.zh: 他们不会相信你的。不，他们不会。
